info.title: Lasso Regression Service
info.description: A service that performs Lasso Regression on a dataset provided as a JSON-encoded Pandas DataFrame.

post.description: Executes Lasso Regression on the provided dataset using the specified independent and dependent variables.

dataframe.description: JSON-encoded representation of a Pandas DataFrame where keys are column names and values are lists of column values

independent_variables.description: List of column names to be used as independent variables

dependent_variable.description: Column name to be used as the dependent variable

alpha.description: Regularization strength parameter for Lasso Regression

model_summary.description: Summary statistics and diagnostics of the trained Lasso Regression model

coefficients.description: Mapping of independent variable names to their corresponding coefficients
